gaps.sentence: We must take ___ for our own health (RESPONSIBLE).
gaps.explanation: 'Take responsibility for something' is the fixed phrase; the -ity noun is needed.

gaps.sentence: He lost his job because of his ___ (HONESTY).
gaps.hint: negative noun needed — he lost his job
gaps.explanation: Losing a job implies wrongdoing, so the negative noun 'dishonesty' (dis- + honesty) is needed.

gaps.sentence: In my opinion, that restaurant is ___ — the food is nothing special (RATE).
gaps.explanation: 'Nothing special' shows the restaurant is praised too much: overrated (over- + rated).

gaps.sentence: He is under a lot of ___ at work (PRESS).
gaps.hint: noun needed after 'a lot of'; fixed phrase 'under ___'
gaps.explanation: 'Under pressure' is the fixed phrase; the noun of 'press' is 'pressure'.

gaps.sentence: Be careful not to ___ the medicine — read the label twice (USE).
gaps.explanation: The prefix mis- means wrongly: misuse means to use something incorrectly. A base verb follows 'not to'.

gaps.sentence: He is very ___ about local history (KNOW).
gaps.explanation: 'Knowledgeable about something' means knowing a lot about it; it is the adjective form of 'knowledge'.

gaps.sentence: The island is ___ , with no permanent residents (HABIT).
gaps.explanation: 'No permanent residents' shows the negative: uninhabited (un- + inhabited). An adjective is needed after 'is'.

gaps.hint: noun needed after 'signs of'; note the spelling change
gaps.explanation: After 'signs of' a noun is needed: recovery (the -er of 'recover' becomes -ery).
